summary: A denied Bash call's permission_denials entry now keeps command, masked and redacted then cut to 200 characters with … appended; other tools are unchanged. Mask also replaces the dashed -Users-<user>- and -home-<user>- forms with USER.
verified: vloop task gate T5 exited 0 and printed ok; go test ./..., go vet, gofmt -l, go mod tidy -diff and GOOS=linux/windows builds are clean.
notes: Runner.cutCommand masks first (Mask), then cuts by runes, so a secret is never split by the cut. The dashed form is handled in Runner.Mask, so it applies to records, run.log and stderr captures alike. TestSessionDenialsKeepToolAndPath now expects the Bash command; added TestCutCommandCountsCharactersAndMasksFirst and TestMaskDashedUserForm. No past record under .vloop/ was rewritten.
